values.note: City of Beatrice: $25 a night, due at check-in, non-refundable. Pay by the QR code at the site, by envelope in the drop box, or by card over the phone during business hours.

fees.source: https://www.beatrice.ne.gov/public-properties/page/riverside-park-campground ('The camping rate is $25.00 per night. Camping fees are due upon check-in. Camping fees are non-refundable. Register using the QR code provided at each site, or at the message board ... If you arrive during business hours, you may pay over the phone with a debit or credit card'; page (c) 2026), read 2026-11-04

hookups.source: https://www.beatrice.ne.gov/public-properties/page/riverside-park-campground ('Electrical hookups at each site (30 and 50 amp)'; 'Water and sewer hookups at each site'), read 2026-11-04

values.note: First-come, first-served; no reservations. Check-out 1 pm.

booking.source: https://www.beatrice.ne.gov/public-properties/page/riverside-park-campground ('Camping at Riverside Park is on a first-come, first-served basis. No reservations are accepted'; 'Maximum 7-day stay. The campsite must be vacated by 1:00 p.m.'), read 2026-11-04

note: City of Beatrice park on the Big Blue River in west Beatrice (Sumner St & River Rd, four blocks north of Court St). Concrete 16x60-ft pads, so big rigs fit. Restrooms, picnic shelters, playgrounds, soccer field, lighted tennis courts. The pads sit by the tennis courts, 150+ m from the river through a continuous belt of trees. --Claude
summary: Everything confirmed on the City of Beatrice page: $25/night (2026 page), FCFS only, 7-day max, 8 concrete 16x60 pads with 30/50-amp, water and sewer, restrooms and hot showers. Provenance moved from note prose to the city page; note cleaned. Not waterfront confirmed.
